ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels comprising approximately 70% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels concentrated at the lateral tips providing a high macro-level contrast ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distal left lobe contains a contiguous white patch with internal grey pixel mottling; distal right lobe features a prominent white patch intersected by vertical black linear streaks; the central region and peduncle junction are characterized by solid, low-intensity black pigmentation.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated angle of approximately 50-60 degrees and a significant bounding-box depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, irregular serration across the trailing edge; right lobe exhibits higher frequency and amplitude peaks (jagged profile), while the left lobe shows a slightly lower amplitude but still inconsistent topography.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curvature on the superior margins of both lobes, tapering to pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of three-dimensional, high-intensity white circular objects (barnacles) concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; several ring-like white pixel clusters (rosette scars) are visible along the lower ventral margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Four distinct, nearly vertical, high-contrast dark linear rake marks on the white surface of the right lobe; irregular, criss-crossing linear pixel disruptions on the left lobe's white patch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle colonization at the distal tips and prominent vertical rake marks on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive ring-shaped white pigment markers (donut-like spots) localized near the lower fluke-peduncle junction.
